summary: @types-beta/sdk silently launches bundled opaque Windows binary on import
details: The package's main entry (dist/index.js) invokes init() as an import side effect. On Windows, init() spawns a bundled./vendor/nanocache.exe using spawn with detached:true, stdio:'ignore', and windowsHide:true, followed by child.unref(), so any consumer that imports or requires this package launches a hidden background native process. The 1.1 MB executable is not built from any source shipped in the tarball, and its readable strings include fragments consistent with a networked agent ('/ws/agen', 'disconne', 'updat', 'exit_cod') — the shape of a WebSocket-based remote agent receiving update/disconnect commands and reporting exit codes. The package name @types-beta/sdk mimics the DefinitelyTyped @types scope, the README claims a sibling package is type-definitions-only, and the launch is logged as 'Optimizing startup' — cover-story framing for silent execution of an opaque bundled binary. Binary sha256: 9c7aaf7078a0e0de15a4855e541946b0952a024e84735f1ad39b0b91ad257851.
